verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler and framework that you install and run entirely on your own machine (`npx sv create`, `npm install`, `npm run dev`). Its source is published on GitHub, and SvelteKit's adapter-static lets you prerender and host the output anywhere, so no vendor-hosted service is required. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, dedicated self-hosting/deployment docs beyond adapter-static, and independent corroboration of self-hosted operation.
